title: D CORE LC-LC 2.0mm 1M Single-Mode Duplex Fiber Patch Cord

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The D CORE LC-LC 2.0mm 1M Single-Mode Duplex Fiber Patch Cord is a premium-quality fiber optic cable designed for fast, stable, and low-loss optical data transmission. Built with OS2 single-mode fiber, LC/UPC connectors, and a durable 2.0mm LSZH jacket, this patch cord ensures maximum performance for FTTH, data centers, telecom networks, and enterprise networking setups. Its 1-meter length makes it ideal for rack-to-rack and device-to-device fiber connectivity.


Key Features


  • LC to LC Duplex Connectors – Ensures precise, high-performance optical connectivity.
  • OS2 Single-Mode Fiber (9/125 µm) – Ideal for long-distance and high-speed data transmission.
  • 1 Meter Length – Perfect for server rooms, OLT/ONU connections, and patch panel setups.
  • 2.0mm LSZH Jacket – Low-smoke, zero-halogen material suitable for indoor safety.
  • Low Insertion Loss (≤0.3 dB) – Stable, high-quality signal performance.
  • High Return Loss (≥50 dB) – Reliable communication without signal degradation.
  • Compatible with All LC/UPC Ports – Routers, switches, OLTs, ONUs, media converters, and SFP modules.
